name: ffmpegu
description: Effect-native FFmpeg and FFprobe services with typed, composable command builders
author: ilchishin.denis@gmail.com

scripts.version:git: git add package.json && git commit -m 'chore: release v$npm_package_version' || echo 'No changes to commit' && git tag v$npm_package_version && git push && git push --tags
scripts.version:minor: $npm_execpath run prepublish && $npm_execpath version minor --no-git-tag-version && $npm_execpath run version:git && $npm_execpath run version:publish
scripts.version:major: $npm_execpath run prepublish && $npm_execpath version major --no-git-tag-version && $npm_execpath run version:git && $npm_execpath run version:publish
scripts.version:patch: $npm_execpath run prepublish && $npm_execpath version patch --no-git-tag-version && $npm_execpath run version:git && $npm_execpath run version:publish
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build
